cards.ex: Effective environmental stewardship is key to securing a healthy future for our planet.
cards.exUz: Samarali ekologik boshqaruv sayyoramiz uchun sog'lom kelajakni ta'minlashning asosiy omili hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni mas'uliyat bilan boshqarish va himoya qilish.

cards.ex: Many companies now offer schemes to offset emissions from air travel.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina kompaniyalar hozirda avia qatnovlardan chiqadigan chiqindilarni qoplash sxemalarini taklif qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Uglerod chiqindilarini kamaytirish uchun kompensatsiya qilish.

cards.ex: The city council is promoting green initiatives to reduce its carbon footprint.
cards.exUz: Shahar kengashi uglerod izini kamaytirish uchun yashil tashabbuslarni ilgari surmoqda.

cards.ex: Overfishing can deplete resources and disrupt marine ecosystems.
cards.exUz: Haddan tashqari baliq ovlash resurslarni kamaytirishi va dengiz ekotizimlarini buzishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The company aims to become carbon-neutral by 2030.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya 2030-yilga kelib uglerod neytral bo'lishni maqsad qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Uglerod chiqindilarini muvozanatlash, nolga teng qilish.

cards.ex: Industrial pollution has led to significant environmental degradation in the region.
cards.exUz: Sanoat ifloslanishi mintaqada sezilarli ekologik buzilishga olib keldi.

cards.ex: Plastic waste is a blight on our oceans.
cards.exUz: Plastik chiqindilar okeanlarimiz uchun qoralovchi.

cards.ex: With new policies, the company is hoping to weather the storm of environmental regulations.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosatlar bilan kompaniya atrof-muhit qoidalarining bo'ronini yengib o'tishga umid qilmoqda.

cards.ex: If we don't act now, future generations will pay the price for our inaction on climate change.
cards.exUz: Agar hozir harakat qilmasak, kelajak avlodlar iqlim o'zgarishi bo'yicha harakatsizligimiz uchun narxini to'laydilar.

cards.ex: Scientists believe that many ecosystems are at a tipping point due to climate change.
cards.exUz: Olimlar iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli ko'plab ekotizimlar hal qiluvchi nuqtada ekanligiga ishonishadi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim, qaytarilmas o'zgarishlar bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: An environmental impact assessment is required before any large construction project can begin.
cards.exUz: Har qanday yirik qurilish loyihasi boshlanishidan oldin ekologik ta'sir baholash talab etiladi.

cards.ex: The government is committed to cutting emissions by 50% by 2030.
cards.exUz: Hukumat 2030 yilga kelib chiqindilarni 50% ga kamaytirishga sodiq.
cards.uzDef: Gazlar va boshqa ifloslantiruvchi moddalarni kamaytirish.

cards.ex: Adopting sustainable practices is crucial for the long-term health of our planet.
cards.exUz: Barqaror amaliyotlarni qabul qilish sayyoramizning uzoq muddatli salomatligi uchun juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Resurslardan oqilona foydalanish va kelajak avlodlar uchun saqlash.

cards.ex: Habitat destruction is a major cause of biodiversity loss.
cards.exUz: Yashash muhitining yo'q qilinishi biologik xilma-xillik yo'qolishining asosiy sababidir.

cards.ex: The amount of money donated was a drop in the bucket compared to what's needed.
cards.exUz: Ehson qilingan pul miqdori kerak bo'lgan narsaga nisbatan dengizdan tomchi edi.

cards.ex: The new regulations could throw a wrench into the company's expansion plans.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar kompaniyaning kengayish rejasiga g'ildirakka tayoq tiqishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Many species are on the brink of extinction due to habitat loss.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina turlar yashash joyining yo'qolishi tufayli yo'q bo'lib ketish yoqasida turibdi.

cards.ex: Scientists are sounding the alarm about the rapid melting of glaciers.
cards.exUz: Olimlar muzliklarning tez erishi haqida ogohlantirish bermoqda.

cards.ex: The new laws are designed to stem the tide of plastic pollution.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonunlar plastik ifloslanish oqimini to'xtatish uchun mo'ljallangan.

cards.ex: We should all try to reduce our ecological footprint.
cards.exUz: Biz hammamiz ekologik izimizni kamaytirishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir kishi yoki jamiyatning atrof-muhitga ta'siri.

cards.ex: The recent floods were a wake-up call about the dangers of climate change.
cards.exUz: Yaqinda bo'lgan suv toshqinlari iqlim o'zgarishining xavflari haqida uyg'onish qo'ng'irog'i bo'ldi.

cards.ex: The city is planning to redevelop the brownfield site into a park.
cards.exUz: Shahar qarovsiz maydonni parkga aylantirishni rejalashtirmoqda.

cards.ex: Companies must comply with strict environmental regulations.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar qat'iy ekologik qoidalarga rioya qilishlari kerak.

cards.ex: Deforestation rates are alarmingly high in some parts of the world.
cards.exUz: Dunyodagi ba'zi hududlarda o'rmonlarning kesilish sur'ati juda yuqori.

cards.ex: The city is implementing new measures to tackle pollution.
cards.exUz: Shahar ifloslanishga qarshi kurashish uchun yangi choralarni amalga oshirmoqda.

cards.ex: Environmental protection should be a priority for all governments.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhit muhofazasi barcha hukumatlar uchun ustuvor vazifa bo'lishi kerak.

cards.ex: Sustainable agriculture is essential for food security.
cards.exUz: Barqaror qishloq xo'jaligi oziq-ovqat xavfsizligi uchun zarur.

cards.ex: After years of neglect, the new environmental policy is a breath of fresh air.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik e'tiborsizlikdan so'ng, yangi ekologik siyosat - bu toza havo.

cards.ex: Residents were warned to stay indoors due to the toxic fumes from the factory fire.
cards.exUz: Aholi zavoddagi yong'indan chiqqan zaharli tutunlar tufayli uyda qolish haqida ogohlantirildi.

cards.ex: Increased conservation efforts are needed to protect endangered species.
cards.exUz: Yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida turgan turlarni himoya qilish uchun qo'shimcha muhofaza qilish harakatlari zarur.
